paragraphs: I’m Swastik, a developer focused on backend systems, networking, and game engine technology. I enjoy working close to the system—building tools and services, and understanding low-level concepts such as sockets, concurrency, and performance.

I’m driven by solving challenging problems and learning through real-world constraints. I regularly participate in team-based projects, hackathons, and community initiatives, where collaboration, ownership, and clear communication matter as much as technical skill.

I’m continuously strengthening my foundation in modern C++, Linux, and CMake, while expanding into cloud and DevOps practices through ongoing EPAM certification programs. I value steady improvement, reliability, and writing software that scales beyond prototypes.
